insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Cancer (of Specified Severity per IRDAI definition)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Designed for insured persons with pre-existing/diagnosed cancer; benefits trigger on diagnosis of Cancer of Specified Severity. Excludes certain in-situ, low-grade, and non-invasive cancers per IRDAI definition.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for cancer treatment hospitalization
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Treatment for Cancer of Specified Severity (excluding carcinoma in situ, CIN-1/2/3, non-melanoma skin carcinoma without metastasis, low-grade prostate/thyroid/bladder/GIST tumors).

ayush_coverage.notes: AYUSH in-patient up to SI in AYUSH Hospital.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Cancer-only critical illness cover (single disease focus)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Plan exclusively for cancer. Indemnifies hospitalization and treatment expenses arising from cancer diagnosis and management.

room_rent_capping: Per policy schedule; proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room category chosen

disease_wise_sub_limits.cancer_treatment: All cancer-related hospitalization, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, surgical procedures covered up to SI

permanent_exclusions: Pre-Existing Disease (other than declared/accepted cancer) until 36 months
notable_exclusions_summary: Cancer-only indemnity plan. Excludes pre-cancerous conditions, in-situ tumors, and very early stage / low-grade variants per IRDAI cancer definition. Non-cancer PEDs have 36-month waiting.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Star Health network. Histological evidence of malignancy required for claim.
